sections/01_introduction.tex.old:
\item We develop a message-passing JADCE receiver for the structured multi-frame AFDM
observation model. The receiver comprises multi-frame linear estimation (MFLE),
which suppresses inter-user interference, and generative-prior-aided joint
denoising (GPJD), which performs MMSE denoising.
In GPJD, a learned density-ratio estimator compares the active and inactive
observation distributions under the effective-channel prior to obtain posterior
probabilities of activity. These probabilities are combined with channel posterior
mean and variance estimates from the learned prior to account for activity
uncertainty in channel estimation. The two modules iteratively exchange Gaussian
extrinsic messages.
sections/01_introduction.tex.new:
\item We develop a message-passing JADCE receiver for the multi-frame AFDM system.
The receiver combines multi-frame linear estimation (MFLE), which suppresses
inter-user interference, with generative-prior-aided joint denoising (GPJD),
which uses the learned effective-channel prior for MMSE denoising.
To reduce errors associated with a Gaussian approximation of the channel
posterior, GPJD employs a learned density-ratio estimator to obtain
posterior probabilities of activity. The two modules iteratively exchange
Gaussian extrinsic messages to perform JADCE.
